description: Two-way binding for form fields. Expands to a value/checked binding plus an input/change listener.
`v-model` modifiers: strip whitespace, cast to number with `parseFloat`, sync on `change` instead of `input`.
Several checkboxes bound to the same array add or remove their `value` when checked or unchecked.
Custom values stored by a single checkbox instead of `true` / `false`.
